name: animdiagram
description: Looping, self-contained animated SVG explainer diagrams: packets travelling along orthogonal connectors with arrival rings and glows, phase captions, ambient streams and growing bars, on a shared CSS-keyframe story clock. Editorial discipline from diagram-design; motion style from SpacetimeDB's scaling series. Ships timeline.py (spec to keyframes), check.py (verifier), preview.py (scrubber), skin.py (dark/light) and export.py (opt-in MP4 render, 1920x1080 or 1080x1920).
